abstract: Thirty-three patients with malignant testicular teratomas and para-aortic metastases exceeding 2 cm in diameter have been treated with radiotherapy, chemotherapy (vinblastine and bleomycin, with or without cis-platinum) or both, followed by surgical excision of the residual para-aortic mass. Removal of a poorly functioning ipsilateral kidney was necessary in 7 cases (21%) and a segment of vena cava was resected in 2 (12.5%) of 16 patients with primary right-sided tumours. Removal was incomplete in only one patient, who had femoral nerve root involvement, and he subsequently died of secondary haemorrhage (operative mortality 3%). Undifferentiated tumour was found in 8 (61%) of 13 patients (Group 1) after radiotherapy, compared with only 2 (15%) of 13 (Group 2) after chemotherapy and radiotherapy, and 4 (57%) of 7 (Group 3) who had chemotherapy only prior to surgery; however, 3 of the Group 3 patients were referred because of evidence of activity in the para-aortic region.
abstract_ja: 精巣悪性奇形腫および傍大動脈転移（直径2cm超）の患者33例に、放射線療法、化学療法（ビンブラスチンとブレオマイシン、シスプラチンの併用の有無を問わない）、またはその両方を行い、その後に残存する傍大動脈腫瘤を外科的に切除した。機能の低下した同側腎の摘出が7例（21%）で必要であり、右側原発の16例中2例（12.5%）では下大静脈の一部を切除した。切除不完全は1例のみで、大腿神経根の浸潤を認め、その後二次的出血で死亡した（手術死亡率3%）。放射線療法後の13例中8例（61%）、放射線療法と化学療法の後の13例中2例（15%）、化学療法のみを行った後の7例中4例（57%）に未分化腫瘍が認められた。ただし化学療法のみを行った群のうち3例は傍大動脈領域に活動性所見があったため紹介されていた。
